newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsuzuka to name Komura MOF vice minister--paper.
newsitem.headline: Mitsuzuka to name Komura MOF vice minister--paper.

text.p: Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka has decided to appoint Takeshi Komura, director-general of the ministry's budget bureau, as the new vice minister, a Japanese financial daily said on Friday.
The appointment, in which Komura will replace current vice minister Tadashi Ogawa, is expected to be formally announced at the end of June, the Nihon Keizai Shimbun said.
In order to deal with Japan's "Big Bang" financial reforms, banking bureau chief Kimio Yamaguchi and securities bureau chief Atsushi Nagano will retain their posts, the paper said.
